name: RoadBench
description: RoadBench is the first multimodal benchmark for comprehensive road damage understanding, pairing high-resolution images of road damages with detailed textual descriptions. It supports training and evaluation of vision-language models for enhanced road condition analysis and infrastructure monitoring.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark from the paper introducing RoadBench, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Includes GPT-driven data generation to expand dataset; introduces RoadCLIP model with domain-specific enhancements.
